description: Publishes an invented game: saves its template (so others can make games with it too) and puts the game live in the feed. The checks run again (up to a minute). stakeOptions for solo luck games: 0 or 10..1000, up to 6 in increasing order.

templateId.description: Optional: an existing template to make this game with, instead of saving this one as a template
